comparison.objective: Extract a stuck pin with repeated slide-hammer impacts; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hook engagement, shaft stabilization, and momentum generation versus quasi-static countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Pin extracted by qualifying impacts and tool returned versus angular stop locked and repeatedly verified.
comparison.reason: Impulse-based tool use is a different physical ability from controlled screw/nut locking.
